Our Story

No Two Crowns Alike

"We don't have a house style. You do."

Five hours is a long time to sit. Long enough for a stranger to become a regular, and a regular to become family. That is the part nobody puts on a price list — the hands, the talk, the afternoon where somebody is looking after you and nothing is expected back.

Then the chair turns around. That is the moment this whole salon is built for — the one where you finally see the back of your own crown. It is why every photograph on this page is shot from behind. That is the view you came for.

Faux locs and Marley twists, bra-length and bob, 4C natural and relaxed, black and honey and auburn. Every one of them left this chair. No two crowns alike — but the same braid runs through every single one.

A room where nobody has to explain their hair.

Before You Message

How To Book

Candy takes appointments on WhatsApp only. Send these four things in your first message and she can give you a date straight away.

1Your name

So she knows who the slot belongs to.

2Your preferred braiding date

Give a couple of options if you can — her book fills up.

3Your hair colour

What you’re working with now, so she can match the piece.

4A picture of the style you want

Including the colour. A picture settles it faster than a paragraph.

Good to know

  • Catalogue styles only. If you send a style that isn’t listed, Candy won’t be able to do it.
  • Muckleneuk / Sunnyside, Pretoria. Appointments only — no house calls.
  • Every price includes the hairpiece. Nothing extra to buy on the day.
  • No short hair. Candy doesn’t take short-hair bookings.
  • Messages are answered later in the day. She’s in the chair while you’re writing — no calls during working hours.

Privacy Policy

Last updated September 2026

It’s Candy’s Classic Touch is a hair salon in Muckleneuk / Sunnyside, Pretoria, South Africa. You can reach us on WhatsApp at +27 68 016 1686.

1. What this website collects

Nothing. There are no forms, no accounts and no sign-ups on this page. We set no cookies and we run no analytics — we cannot see who visits.

The page does load a few things from other companies, and those companies will see your device’s IP address and browser when it does: Google Fonts (the typefaces), Cloudflare / cdnjs (the icons) and Unsplash (a small number of reference photographs). Everything else, including all of Candy’s own photographs, is built into this page and loads from nowhere.

2. What Candy collects when you book

Booking happens on WhatsApp, not here. When you message, you send your name, your preferred date, your hair colour and a picture of the style you want. That information is used only to arrange and carry out your appointment and to contact you about it. It is kept only as long as it is needed for that. It is never sold, and it is not shared with anyone else.

3. Photographs of your hair

Candy photographs finished work for her catalogue and social media. If you would rather not be photographed, say so — before or afterwards, either is fine. If a photograph of you is already published and you want it taken down, message us and it will be removed.

4. WhatsApp

Your conversation happens inside WhatsApp and is also covered by WhatsApp’s own privacy terms, which we do not control.

5. Your rights

Under South Africa’s Protection of Personal Information Act you may ask what personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Message us on WhatsApp and we will see to it.

6. Children

We do not knowingly collect information about anyone under 18 without a parent or guardian involved.

7. Changes

If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it.

Terms of Service

Last updated September 2026

1. Booking

Appointments only. No walk-ins and no house calls. To book, message +27 68 016 1686 with your name, your preferred braiding date, your hair colour, and a picture of the style you want including the colour. Your appointment is confirmed only once Candy has replied and agreed a date with you.

2. Styles

Candy does only the styles in her catalogue. If you send a style that is not listed, she will not be able to do it. She does not take short-hair bookings.

3. Prices

The prices on this page and in the WhatsApp catalogue include the hairpiece. Prices can change; the price confirmed on WhatsApp when you book is the one that applies.

4. Replies

Candy is in the chair during the day. Messages are answered later in the day, and she cannot take calls while she is working.

5. Changing or cancelling

If you need to move or cancel an appointment, tell us on WhatsApp as early as you can so the slot can go to someone else.

6. Your hair and scalp

Please mention anything relevant before your appointment — scalp conditions, recent chemical treatments, allergies, or a previous reaction to a hairpiece. Protective styles place tension on the hair, so say something straight away if anything feels too tight.

7. This website

The photographs of finished work belong to It’s Candy’s Classic Touch; please do not reuse them without permission. A small number of images are marked “style reference” — those are illustrative photographs of a comparable look, not work done at this salon. Details such as how long a style lasts or how long it takes in the chair are guidance, not guarantees.

8. Contact

WhatsApp +27 68 016 1686.
